description: Use this when the user wants to change which jobs (Stellen) they search for: job titles (Wunschjob), places, salary, industries, company sizes, employers to avoid. Pass all criteria from get_search_criteria with only that change; omitted ones are emptied. Keeps the resume; applies from the next job matches. While the current ones stand, fails with zu_frueh and the time from which it works. Scope: cv:schreiben.
name: set_search_criteria
title: Change your job search criteria
